title: Fourier weight above an integer threshold
statement: For a Boolean cube of dimension $n$, a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and an integer $k\ge 0$, the total Fourier weight on subsets of size greater than $k$, when the threshold is viewed as a real number, equals the total Fourier weight on subsets of size greater than $k$ defined using cardinality as a natural number.
